name: Dubhe Chant
description: The first star of the Grand Chariot wheels into alignment with your blade.  The Chariot shows death, and your cuts begin to mean it.  +10% melee damage.

name: Merak Chant
description: The second star lends its turning to your wrists.  Your sword moves a shade faster than your foe expects.  Faster melee attacks.

name: Phegda Chant
description: The third star settles behind your ribs like ballast.  You stand against blows that would have moved you.  Slight bash and cut armor.

name: Megrez Chant
description: The fourth star keeps your dantian fed while the blade works.  Sustained swordplay costs you less.  Reduced stamina consumption in melee.

name: Alioth Chant
description: The fifth star sharpens the eye behind the blade.  You see the cut before you make it.  +1 melee accuracy.

name: Mizar Chant
description: The sixth star teaches your body to be where the blade is not.  +1 dodge chance.

name: Alkaid Chant
description: The seventh star burns at the handle of the Chariot.  You have learned the Northsword's true name and the last form of the law.  Slightly faster movement; grants Possessed Northsword.

name: Sevenstar Convergence
description: All seven stars of the Grand Chariot turn as one within you.  The shape of the Chariot shows death, and you have become its pointer.  +10% melee damage, +1 dodge chance.
